local_context.value: Eagle Lake has a humid subtropical climate (Koppen Cfa); elevation 157 ft. NWS Tampa Bay: the West Central Florida rainy (thunderstorm) season runs May 25 to October 10; late May through June, hail, damaging winds, waterspouts, heavy rainfall and frequent lightning are common (https://www.weather.gov/tbw/rainyseason). The city sits on Eagle Lake, near Lake McLeod; incorporated October 1921 as Town of Eagle Lake, reincorporated November 1975; earlier industries were a brickyard, turpentine mill and citrus packing houses. No official housing-age figure found.

neighborhoods.value: PARTIAL, developer/listing-site sources only: Landings at Eagle Lake (Bingham Road), Eagle Hammock, Ranches at Lake McLeod (Bomber Road, 1,160-lot project, planned), Lake Meadows. No official list found.

place_entities.value: 1) Eagle Lake (the lake the city is named for; boat ramp, municipal park with pavilion, playground, beach, restrooms). 2) Lake McLeod (nearby, boat ramp). 3) Crystal Beach Pavilion (historic, mid-1950s to 1960s, southwest shore; per Wikipedia). 4) Eagle Lake municipal park / City Hall complex (skate park, courts). City Wikipedia page https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eagle_Lake,_Florida, Wikidata Q1969826. No Wikidata entries found for the lake or parks; Lake McLeod has no Wikipedia article.

permit_office.value: City of Eagle Lake Building Department, City Hall, 75 N. 7th Street, Eagle Lake FL 33839, (863) 229-5032; online permitting via the Polk County Accela portal (https://aca-prod.accela.com/POLKCO/Login.aspx). Appointments recommended for in-person visits.
